runtimeAsset.foliage: Retained as original runtime scene, omitted here; included as exact bake occluder
runtimeAsset.pbrBinding: Material slot names only; remap every slot to original already-loaded runtime PBR material. All scan images retained in immutable bake master.

runtime.diffuseReplacement: Zero all runtime direct+indirect diffuse on listed groups, then use PI*whiteRadiance as irradiance for BRDF_Lambert. Preserve runtime specular/glass/water.

runtimePolicy.staticGI: fullHDR integration replaces all runtime diffuse on mapped groups; runtime direct specular remains
runtimePolicy.dynamicDiffuseAndShadows: deSun IBL + one DirectionalLight with extracted beam
runtimePolicy.water: fullHDR for sky reflection; do not additionally add extracted sun specular to that same reflection

environmentOverride.coordinates: Blender background Generated world direction; equirectangular u=-atan2(y,x)/(2*pi)+0.5
environmentOverride.directSunPolicy: Full HDR radiance, analytic SUN energy multiplied by sunScale exactly once

lightingCalibration.reason: Explicit cross-renderer light calibration; HDR radiance has no absolute photometric calibration.

runtimeDecompositionRevision.reason: Blender generated-image writer was applying sRGB transfer to HDR output; Non-Color output preserves the original scene-linear radiance. Actual encoded asset reloaded and checked.
runtimeDecompositionRevision.staticInputSignatureScope: Actual per-group bake signatures still cover fullHDR SHA, MappingZ, world strength, sun/practical calibration, UV master, Ns and padding; the runtime decomposition package fingerprint is a separate identity.

publication.scope: Complete geometry/illumination package integrity; actual runtime and artistic acceptance remain separate.
